human_verdict_2026-09-11: ISOLATED 'hmm' clips sound INHUMAN and are REJECTED by ear in every form tried: v3 clone speaking the word Hmm (robotic), ElevenLabs SFX hmm with wandering pitch (inhuman), SFX hmm with steady flat pitch (still inhuman), a bare mm or a breath (not a hmmmm). WHAT WORKS (human_confirmed 'much better'): fuse the hmmmm INTO a whole spoken line in Embry's own v3 clone voice, e.g. 'Hmmmm, let me see.' and high-intensity 'Hmmmm... [sighs] let me dig into that.' No separate clip, no seam. Rules: cap <=2 fused openers per conversation; 10 varied 'let me see' tails for no-repeat; band by complexity (>=3-part problem -> high hmmmm+sigh); pool at outputs/sfx-library/fused-hmm/ (manifest.json). Also: cover speech renders at --pace slow (~18% longer) to buy background solve time; SONG hums (not thinking) gain-fit UNDER speech (scripts/filler_gain.py: -1.5..-5 dB from measured speech RMS, varying per use, never louder than speech). This clips[] block below is the SUPERSEDED isolated-clip design, retained only as the rejected baseline.
note: Filled-pause / thinking vocalizations (grounded: filled pauses cluster BEFORE the hard content and aid listener comprehension — Frontiers Psychol 2026, Fox Tree; Polya restatement pairs with them). Pre-computed ElevenLabs clips inserted at a clause/sentence boundary BEFORE the effortful answer, same boundary rule as emotion SFX — never mid-clause, never overlaid. Band mirrors the um>uh difficulty gradient: light mm for a small hitch, longer hmm for a genuinely weighty problem. Contented non-melodic hum is idle-only. Durations/quality human-verified by ear. Song-melody humming is NOT here: recognizable copyrighted melodies are an infringement risk (see SKILL.md) — only public-domain/original tunes, generated separately.

clips.use_when: A small hitch before a minor answer; light acknowledgment that a question landed.
clips.avoid_when: Quick factual replies where any hesitation reads as stalling.

clips.use_when: Genuinely considering a moderately hard question before answering; buys real planning/compute time.
clips.avoid_when: Celebratory or upbeat turns, where deliberation dampens the affect.

clips.use_when: A weighty or ambiguous problem that deserves visible deliberation; pairs with a concise restatement (Polya step 1).
clips.avoid_when: Simple lookups, where long deliberation feels performative.

clips.use_when: Backchannel acknowledgment while the user is still talking or to confirm you followed.
clips.avoid_when: As a stand-in for an actual answer the user is waiting on.

gen.text: Soft short contented human hum from a woman, gentle, non-melodic, no recognizable tune, natural.

clips.use_when: Idle/companionable moments — relaxed presence, not thinking through a task.
clips.avoid_when: Mid-task or while the user awaits an answer; and never reproduce a recognizable copyrighted melody.
